items.title: August Laurent Interview, 1960-03-21
items.q: Buddy P.T. had a good go at one time. But he lost it... he had a good band. They'd follow him anywhere he'd go.

ctx.x: Which was the best band for the dance band in those days? The best band? No, the dance for the orchestra for the...

Well, the orchestra bands, I'm going to tell you, in them times, Buddy P.T. had a good go at one time. But he lost it, like I'm telling you, just like Rickard did, taking too many deposits. Yeah. They lost confidence in it. But he had a good band. They'd follow him anywhere he'd go. Yeah. Joe Oliver was the same way. He had a good band. He was here. Manuel Perez had a great band, playing upon the Pissian Temple.
